query:
INSERT INTO segments (corpus_id, idx, start_line, end_line, text, carry_lines)
                 VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 0)
                 ON CONFLICT(corpus_id, idx) DO UPDATE SET
                   start_line = excluded.start_line,
                   end_line = excluded.end_line,
                   text = excluded.text,
                   carry_lines = 0,
                   no_promote = 0
